steps.text:
**Report**

- **CLI install:** `noacg` was not on the PATH, so I ran `npm install -g /mnt/session/uploads/noacg-cli.tgz`. `noacg --version` now reports 0.11.0.
- **certutil:** It was already present at `/usr/bin/certutil`, so nothing was installed. I created the NSS database and imported the four CA certs from `/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/`.
- **Browser:** `noacg doctor` found Google Chrome on its own, so `NOACG_BROWSER` was not needed. Deployment is `https://noacg.studio`. Not logged in, which is expected since nothing is saved from here.
- **Scaffold:** `Plumbing check` (scoreboard, neutral) was created in `/workspace/graphic`, with no design changes.
- **Validate:** 0 errors, 0 warnings. Screenshots are in `/mnt/session/outputs/shots/`. I read `onair.png`, which shows the neutral placeholder HOME 0 / AWAY 0 on a dark box.
- **Record:** `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json` and `record.zip`, digest `sha256:f448faee…`. Nothing was saved to the library.
- **Coverage:** 57 frames and 2 crops in `/mnt/session/outputs/coverage`, with no findings and no failures. I read `sample-video.jpg`, which shows the scoreboard correctly over the video ground. The record was taken before coverag...
